How to read the atlas

Amber arrows point from the selected subreddit to its counterparts. Violet arrows point toward the selected subreddit. The map highlights up to 12 counterparts with embeddings; the list includes all matching counterparts.

Nodes counts all communities in the loaded dataset. Links counts negative-labeled hyperlinks across that dataset in the selected date range. The dossier and Activity tab show links for the selected subreddit. A self-link contributes to both directional counts and once to the network-wide count.

Negative fractions use all hyperlink rows in the relevant direction as the denominator. Labels come from a classifier. Months use UTC, and repeated hyperlinks count separately.

New SNAP exports use a two-dimensional UMAP projection of shared-user embeddings. Earlier exports can still be loaded. The projection is best read as a guide to local neighborhoods. Communities without embeddings remain searchable. The illustrative dataset uses fictional communities and sample counts.
